title: Google Earth map of Montana early-1976 UAP sighting placemarks
description: Attachment 3 (page 39): a Google Earth satellite map of a Montana region overlaid with clustered placemarks labeled with sites and dates from roughly 1/76 through 10/76, including Benton Lake, Fort Benton, Square Butte Area and Monarch. Yellow highway lines and Google Earth navigation controls frame the image.
